prompt: Write src/title.mjs with `urlName(title)`. It returns the title as a lowercase name with the words joined by `-`, with slugger from vendor/slugger.mjs. A letter with an accent must keep its base letter, as in `é` to `e`. An `&` is the word `and`. A `.` between two digits stays in the name, as in `4.5`, and each other `.` goes. The letters `ł`, `ø`, and `đ` keep their base letter (`l`, `o`, `d`), and `ß` is `ss`. A `-` or a `_` between words is a word break, as in `pre-built` to `pre-built` and `snake_case` to `snake-case`. Each other mark goes too. The name has at most 20 characters, and it ends at a whole word. The folder vendor/ has the installed version of the library, and it is not changed. Read docs/slugger.md first.
